notes: DealGro is a free commercial real estate deal-alert service. Investors and buyers set a buy box — property types, markets, and price range — and get email alerts when new listings match. Coverage focuses on mobile home parks (MHP), multifamily, RV parks, self-storage, flex, and industrial. DealGro is not a brokerage and does not charge to sign up: no credit card required, and you can unsubscribe anytime. Start at https://www.dealgro.com
